content.content: The store read interface reads node documents from jj: a node's bytes come from the change that owns it. Reads cross the jj seam under the caller-supplied binary and root.
content.rationale: The working copy materialises only the nodes present at its own revision; a node recorded later in the stack is invisible to a filesystem read, so log, validate and resolution would silently see a partial graph whenever the working copy sits earlier in history. D1b (xwyryumr) makes the node id the owning change id, so reading a node at its own change is well-defined from anywhere in history. D4 (mqqwzvwz) keeps navigation parentage-independent; reading by change id follows the id, not parentage, so this stays within it. S2-ifs keeps the read reach its own, so the move to jj cannot pull the write, markers or exclude interfaces along.
